site_picker.heading: Choose your site
site_picker.empty: No sites are set up on this iPad yet. Ask a manager.

name_picker.heading: Tap your name to sign in
name_picker.no_operators: No active operators are assigned to {{site}}. Ask a manager to add you in the portal.

keypad.error_incorrect: PIN incorrect or account locked. Try again.

queue.heading: Today's queue
queue.no_sync_yet: No MyMRC sync has run yet.
queue.open_intro: You started these and they aren't submitted yet. Finish them first.
queue.held_intro: Open loads another operator started. Tap one to see it, and take it over if they've stepped away.
queue.withdrawn_heading: Taken off today’s list by MyMRC

takeover.explain: Whoever holds a load is the one who closes it. If they have stepped away, you can take it over — the handover is recorded with your name.
takeover.confirm_detail: You become the operator who closes it, and this handover is recorded.
takeover.error: That did not go through. Try again.
takeover.error_moved: {{name}} took this load over first — it is theirs now, not yours. Nothing you entered was lost.
takeover.error_not_open: This load has already been closed out, so there is nothing left to take over.
takeover.not_takeable: This load is no longer open on the dock, so it cannot be taken over here. Ask a manager.

workflow.closed_body: This load is closed — there is nothing left to do on it. Nothing you entered was lost.

stage_bol.heading: 1. Bill of Lading
stage_bol.subheading: Photo the BOL before the truck opens.

stage_weight.heading: 2. Weight ticket
stage_weight.subheading_choose: Optional. Add the weight ticket if the carrier provided one.
stage_weight.subheading_add: Photo the ticket and enter the weight in pounds (1–100,000).

stage_door.heading: 3. Door open
stage_door.subheading: Photo the open trailer. Your unload timer starts now.

stage_decision.heading: 4. Inspect the load
stage_decision.subheading: If the load is acceptable, begin unloading. Otherwise reject it.

stage_stacks.subheading_pick_mode: Choose how you want to count this load.

stage_reject.heading: 5. Reject load
stage_reject.note_required: Tell us what happened — a few words is enough.
stage_reject.note_placeholder: Anything else worth recording. Voice-to-text is OK.

load_reject.open: Found a problem with this load?
load_reject.heading: Reject this load
load_reject.subheading: Use this when the load itself is bad — bed bugs, contamination, damage — and you are not taking it. The truck is turned away and this stops being a delivery.
load_reject.consequence_counted: This voids the {{stacks}} stacks you have counted ({{units}} units) and records the load as rejected. It cannot be undone.
load_reject.consequence_uncounted: This records the load as rejected. Nothing has been counted yet. It cannot be undone.
load_reject.photo_required: A photo of the problem is required.
load_reject.unsent: Some of your taps have not reached the server yet. Wait a moment — this unlocks as soon as they land.
load_reject.failed: Could not reject this load. Try again.

load_void.heading: Close this load
load_void.subheading: Use this when the load was never really worked — you tapped the wrong haul, or the truck never came. It will not count as a delivery, and the haul goes back on the list so it can be started again.
load_void.note_required: Add a short note so this makes sense later.
load_void.failed: Couldn't close this load. Try again.

load_review.heading: What you've entered so far
load_review.close: ← Back to what I was doing
load_review.weight_failed: Couldn't save the weight. Try again.
load_review.reopen_explainer: This puts the load back to counting so you can add or remove stacks. Your unload time stays as it was — going back to fix a number will not make your unload look slow.
load_review.unsent: You still have work on this load waiting to send. You can look at everything here, but fixing has to wait until it has sent — otherwise the older entry could land on top of your fix.

photo.queued_caption: Saved on iPad — will upload when online
photo.signed_out_caption: Your sign-in expired. Sign in on this iPad and this photo sends by itself.
photo.error_upload: That picture did not send. Tap to try again.
photo.other_operator: This load is signed in under another operator, so this picture cannot be sent under your name. Have that operator sign in on this iPad.
photo.count_full: {{count}} of {{max}} photos — that is all this step holds
photo.limit_reached: This step already holds {{max}} photos. That is the most it takes, so this one cannot be sent.

auth_login.heading: Sign in
auth_login.sso_only_hint: Managers and admins only. Operators sign in on the iPad.
auth_login.error_access_denied: Your Microsoft account isn't authorized for DR3-Vision. Ask an admin to add you.
auth_login.error_not_configured: Microsoft sign-in isn't configured yet. Ask an admin to finish the setup.
auth_login.error_session_expired: Your sign-in session expired. Sign in again to continue.

update_prompt.title: A new version is available
update_prompt.body: Tap reload to get the latest. Your saved work is kept.

common.not_activated_body: The inventory tools for {{site}} aren't switched on yet. Ask a manager.
common.queued: Saved on this iPad — will send when you reconnect
common.resume_yours: You started this — tap to open it
common.started_by: Started by {{name}} — tap to take it over

hub.heading: Daily check
hub.caption: {{site}} · {{name}}
hub.card_queue_body: Capture a load at the dock
hub.card_hauls_body: Search every haul MyMRC has for this site
hub.card_dropoff_body: Someone dropped mattresses at the door

hauls.heading: All portal hauls
hauls.caption: Everything MyMRC shows for {{site}} — newest first
hauls.pending_note: Scheduled but not delivered yet — units read 0 until MyMRC records the delivery.
hauls.empty_no_hauls: No portal hauls for this site.
hauls.late_cta: The truck is here now — check it in
hauls.late_confirm: Check in {{haul}}, booked for {{date}}, as arriving today?
hauls.late_failed: Couldn't check it in. Pull down to refresh, then try again.
hauls.stale_day: This page is from an earlier day. Reload to check in today's hauls.
hauls.empty_no_hauls_why: This site has no MyMRC portal feed, so there is nothing to list here. That is normal — use the queue for today’s trucks.
hauls.withdrawn_what_to_do: If the truck is here, call the office. Once they put it back in MyMRC it comes back on this screen within the hour — you do not need to do anything on the iPad.

inbound.heading: Confirm inbound
inbound.intro: Check each day's received counts. Tap Confirm if it looks right, or Correct it.
inbound.office_locked: Entered by the office — a manager can change it.
inbound.per_load_locked: This day was counted truck-by-truck on the queue.
inbound.err_office: This day was entered by the office. Ask a manager to change it.
inbound.err_per_load: This day was already counted truck-by-truck. Confirm it on the queue.
inbound.err_split: Program + non-program must add up to the total.
inbound.empty_why: Nothing has been received here yet. Inbound days appear once a truck is checked in on the queue.

count.heading: Count on hand
count.intro: Count the mattresses on hand, then enter the numbers below.
count.result_match: Right on — matches what the system expected.
count.err_split: Program + non-program must add up to the total counted.
count.confirm_decrease: This replaces {{prior}} with {{next}} — a decrease of {{n}} ({{pct}}%).
count.confirm_increase: This replaces {{prior}} with {{next}} — an increase of {{n}} ({{pct}}%).
count.confirm_first: This is the first count for this site. Nothing is being replaced.
count.hold_heading: A manager has to approve this
count.hold_body: This count is a big change from what is on record, so it is being held until a manager approves it. Your numbers are saved — nothing is lost.
count.hold_remote_note: No manager here right now? Leave this screen — a manager can approve it from their own computer.
count.hold_discard_reason: Why are you throwing it away?
count.hold_discarded: Count thrown away. Nothing was saved.
count.err_self_release: You entered this count, so you cannot approve it. A manager has to.
count.err_not_manager: That person cannot approve counts at this site.
count.void_intro: If a count was entered by mistake, you can remove it here. Only today's counts, and only at this site.
count.void_none: No counts have been entered today.
count.void_confirm_body: This removes the count of {{total}} from {{time}}. The floor goes back to what it was before that count was entered. Nothing is deleted — the office can still see it.
count.void_confirm_other: {{name}} entered this count. Removing it will be recorded under your name.
count.void_err_prior_day: That count was taken on {{day}}, not today. Ask the office to change it.
count.void_err_gone: That count is not there any more.
count.hold_gone: A manager already dealt with this one. Enter the count again if you still need to.

processed.heading: Confirm processed
processed.err_closed: Today is closed. Ask an admin to reopen it.

error.heading: Something went wrong
error.body: That didn't save. Try again — your last entry may not have gone through.

connection.uploads_blocked: Photos can’t upload — tell a manager
connection.uploads_blocked_detail: {{count}} photos are waiting. Counts are still saving normally.

conflicts.heading: Entries that need you
conflicts.intro: These could not be sent automatically. Nothing has been lost and nothing has been changed — choose what happens to each one.
conflicts.empty: Nothing is stuck. Everything you entered has been sent.
conflicts.discard_reason: Why are you discarding this entry?
conflicts.why_wrong_day: It was for a different day, so it was not sent. The iPad only files today.
conflicts.why_session: Your sign-in expired before this was sent.
conflicts.why_refused: The server would not accept this.
conflicts.why_other_operator: This photo belongs to a load signed in under another operator. Have that operator sign in on this iPad and try again.
conflicts.why_upload_blocked: Photo storage was unreachable. It is safe to try again now.
conflicts.why_manager_hold: This count is large enough to need a manager. It is stored safely and waiting for approval — retrying will not speed it up.
conflicts.why_taken_over: Another operator took this load over, so this entry could not be sent under your name. It is stored safely — whoever holds the load now can enter it, or discard this.
conflicts.unreadable: This iPad cannot read its saved entries right now, so this list may be incomplete. Nothing has been lost. Close the app and open it again — if it still says this, tell a manager.
conflicts.discard_reason_required: Type a reason before discarding. Nothing was discarded.

dropoff.heading: Drop-off
dropoff.caption: Walk-up drop-off at {{site}}
dropoff.intro: Pick the type, count the mattresses, take one photo, then send.
dropoff.photo_required: A photo is required for every drop-off.

not_found.heading: That screen is not here
not_found.body: This link does not go anywhere on this iPad. Nothing you entered was lost.

nav.log_out_aria: Log out and return to the name picker
